messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.content:
當你把球往上拋，除了初始推力之外（這只在瞬間作用），之後唯一持續對它施加力量的是重力。  
因此：

| 項目 | 數值 |
|------|-----|
| 重力加速度 \(g\) | 約 \(-9.8~\text{m/s}^{2}\) |

* 記號「−」表示方向與球最初運動方向相反，即下落方向；若僅談大小，可寫作 \(9.8~\text{m/s}^{2}\)。  

所以不管你用多快的速率抛起球，只要忽略空氣阻力，其加速度都保持為約 **\(9.8\,\mathrm{m/s^{2}}\)** 向下。
message.reasoning:
The user asks (in Chinese): "If a ball is thrown upward at 5 m/s directly up, what acceleration will it achieve?" They likely mean what's its acceleration? In physics, when throwing upward, the only acceleration acting on the ball after launch is gravitational acceleration downward (~ -9.81 m/s^2). So answer: acceleration of -9.8 m/s² downwards.
